limits: Live proof covers real standalone Local conversations, user/assistant Markdown and Files rich preview, all5 built-in themes, desktop/phone, one level of nested alert. Shared renderer consumers and library embedding are covered by code/focused tests; no authenticated Cloud, ACP or arbitrary host-palette visual pass is claimed.

No universal claim for arbitrary nesting depth or syntax-token colors. Existing icons, labels, parsing and ordinary blockquote styling are preserved; the migration adjusts alert ink/tint and scoped prose descendants.

Raw model-entry recordings include normal model wait time. After Files video idle trimming yielded4.3seconds from73.6seconds wall time; clean screenshots prove the final matching states. Edited film must use actual clips/screenshots without fabricating UI.

superseded.reason: Initial capture pass lacked complete typography measurements and showed timestamp hover overlay in one chat shot. Final phone Files shots hide the actual file tree for legibility in both phases; older narrow shots kept locally and excluded from selected set.

implementation.behavior: Five alert families use theme-aware ink, tint and scoped readable Markdown prose descendants.
